name: voxel-tool
description: MagicaVoxel .vox read/write and 3D voxel model viewer - core library + framework-agnostic viewer + React/Vue/Solid/Preact/Svelte/Qwik components

scripts.build: npm run build -w @voxel-tool/core --if-present && npm run build -w @voxel-tool/mesh --if-present && npm run build -w @voxel-tool/viewer --if-present && npm run build -w @voxel-tool/exporter --if-present && npm run build -w @voxel-tool/react --if-present && npm run build -w @voxel-tool/vue --if-present && npm run build -w @voxel-tool/solid --if-present && npm run build -w @voxel-tool/preact --if-present && npm run build -w @voxel-tool/svelte --if-present && npm run build -w @voxel-tool/qwik --if-present && npm run build -w voxel-tool-docs --if-present && npm run build -w voxel-tool-editor --if-present
